title: BGT-winning captain Ajinkya Rahane retires from all formats
desc: Ajinkya Rahane has called time on his playing career that took him from Mumbai's domestic cricket circuit to some of India's greatest Test triumphs. From his defining century in Australia's 2020-21 series to repeated battles for a spot in the Test team, Rahane leaves behind a career built on resilience, timing and putting his team ahead of himself.

title: Cigarette smoke extract primes airway cells for greater nanoplastic damage
desc: Researchers found that cigarette smoke extract weakened epithelial barriers and increased the proportion of human airway cells that were polystyrene nanoparticle-positive. Sequential treatment caused greater metabolic disruption and increased mucus-producing cells, suggesting heightened epithelial vulnerability, although the findings are limited to in vitro models.
